title.hu: Rövidített vonatkozó mondatok (the man sitting there, the book written by …, the first to arrive)
title.en: Reduced Relative Clauses (the man sitting there, the book written by …, the first to arrive)
title.es: Las oraciones de relativo reducidas (the man sitting there, the book written by …, the first to arrive)
title.de: Verkürzte Relativsätze (the man sitting there, the book written by …, the first to arrive)

text.hu: A vonatkozó mellékmondat rövidíthető: a „who/which + be” elhagyható, és az ige -ing alakban vagy múlt idejű igenévben marad. „The man who is sitting there” helyett „the man sitting there”, „the book which was written by Orwell” helyett „the book written by Orwell”. Az „első, utolsó, egyetlen” után to-infinitív áll: „the first person to arrive”. A spanyol hosszú „el hombre que está sentado ahí” szerkezetet az angol rövid névutós igenévvel mondja.
text.en: A relative clause can be shortened: “who/which + be” can be dropped and the verb stays in the -ing form or as a past participle. Instead of “the man who is sitting there” you say “the man sitting there”, instead of “the book which was written by Orwell” you say “the book written by Orwell”. After “first, last, only” comes a to-infinitive: “the first person to arrive”. The long Spanish “el hombre que está sentado ahí” is said in English with a short participle.
text.es: Una oración de relativo se puede acortar: «who/which + be» se puede omitir y el verbo queda en forma -ing o como participio pasado. En lugar de «the man who is sitting there» se dice «the man sitting there», en lugar de «the book which was written by Orwell» se dice «the book written by Orwell». Después de «first, last, only» va un to-infinitivo: «the first person to arrive». El largo «el hombre que está sentado ahí» del español se dice en inglés con un participio corto.
text.de: Ein Relativsatz lässt sich verkürzen: «who/which + be» kann wegfallen, und das Verb bleibt in der -ing-Form oder als Partizip Perfekt. Statt «the man who is sitting there» sagt man «the man sitting there», statt «the book which was written by Orwell» sagt man «the book written by Orwell». Nach «first, last, only» steht ein to-Infinitiv: «the first person to arrive». Das lange spanische «el hombre que está sentado ahí» sagt man im Englischen mit einem kurzen Partizip.

text.hu: A who + be + -ing vagy a who + jelen idejű ige helyett áll: „The girl sitting next to me” = the girl who is sitting next to me; „people living in cities” = people who live in cities.
text.en: It replaces who + be + -ing or who + a present verb: “The girl sitting next to me” = the girl who is sitting next to me; “people living in cities” = people who live in cities.
text.es: Reemplaza a who + be + -ing o who + un verbo en presente: «The girl sitting next to me» = the girl who is sitting next to me; «people living in cities» = people who live in cities.
text.de: Es ersetzt who + be + -ing oder who + ein Präsensverb: «The girl sitting next to me» = the girl who is sitting next to me; «people living in cities» = people who live in cities.

text.hu: A which/that + be + igenév helyett áll: „The book written by Orwell” = the book which was written by Orwell; „cars made in Mexico” = cars which are made in Mexico.
text.en: It replaces which/that + be + participle: “The book written by Orwell” = the book which was written by Orwell; “cars made in Mexico” = cars which are made in Mexico.
text.es: Reemplaza a which/that + be + participio: «The book written by Orwell» = the book which was written by Orwell; «cars made in Mexico» = cars which are made in Mexico.
text.de: Es ersetzt which/that + be + Partizip: «The book written by Orwell» = the book which was written by Orwell; «cars made in Mexico» = cars which are made in Mexico.

title.hu: A to-infinitív: first, last, only, felsőfok
title.en: The to-infinitive: first, last, only, superlatives
title.es: El to-infinitivo: first, last, only, superlativos
title.de: Der to-Infinitiv: first, last, only, Superlative

text.hu: A the first / the last / the only / the next / felsőfok után to-infinitív áll: „the first person to arrive”, „the only one to know”, „the best way to learn”. Hasznos még: „something to eat”, „a place to stay”.
text.en: After the first / the last / the only / the next / a superlative comes a to-infinitive: “the first person to arrive”, “the only one to know”, “the best way to learn”. Also useful: “something to eat”, “a place to stay”.
text.es: Después de the first / the last / the only / the next / un superlativo va un to-infinitivo: «the first person to arrive», «the only one to know», «the best way to learn». También útil: «something to eat», «a place to stay».
text.de: Nach the first / the last / the only / the next / einem Superlativ steht ein to-Infinitiv: «the first person to arrive», «the only one to know», «the best way to learn». Nützlich auch: «something to eat», «a place to stay».

text.hu: Hivatalos szövegben gyakori: „Anyone wishing to apply should contact the office.” „All passengers traveling to Madrid…” A rövidítés nem használható minden esetben: egy befejezett múltbeli esemény nem -ing alakkal áll („the man who called yesterday”, nem „the man calling yesterday”).
text.en: Common in official texts: “Anyone wishing to apply should contact the office.” “All passengers traveling to Madrid…” The shortening does not work in every case: a finished past event does not take -ing (“the man who called yesterday”, not “the man calling yesterday”).
text.es: Es común en textos oficiales: «Anyone wishing to apply should contact the office.» «All passengers traveling to Madrid…» El acortamiento no sirve en todos los casos: un hecho pasado terminado no lleva -ing («the man who called yesterday», no «the man calling yesterday»).
text.de: In amtlichen Texten üblich: «Anyone wishing to apply should contact the office.» «All passengers traveling to Madrid…» Die Verkürzung geht nicht in jedem Fall: ein abgeschlossenes vergangenes Ereignis steht nicht mit -ing («the man who called yesterday», nicht «the man calling yesterday»).

text.hu: Nem „the man sit there”, hanem „the man sitting there”. A rövidítésnél nincs ragozott ige: sem „the man sits there is”, sem „the book was written by Orwell is”.
text.en: Not “the man sit there”, but “the man sitting there”. In the shortened form there is no finite verb: neither “the man sits there is” nor “the book was written by Orwell is”.
text.es: No «the man sit there», sino «the man sitting there». En la forma acortada no hay un verbo conjugado: ni «the man sits there is» ni «the book was written by Orwell is».
text.de: Nicht «the man sit there», sondern «the man sitting there». In der verkürzten Form gibt es kein finites Verb: weder «the man sits there is» noch «the book was written by Orwell is».

text.hu: Az -ing alak egyidejűséget vagy általános igazságot jelöl; a múlt idejű igenév szenvedő. Aki tegnap hívott: „the man who called yesterday”, nem „the man calling yesterday”.
text.en: The -ing form marks something happening at the same time or a general truth; the past participle is passive. The man who called yesterday: “the man who called yesterday”, not “the man calling yesterday”.
text.es: La forma -ing marca algo simultáneo o una verdad general; el participio pasado es pasivo. El hombre que llamó ayer: «the man who called yesterday», no «the man calling yesterday».
text.de: Die -ing-Form markiert etwas Gleichzeitiges oder eine allgemeine Wahrheit; das Partizip Perfekt ist passiv. Der Mann, der gestern anrief: «the man who called yesterday», nicht «the man calling yesterday».

speak.hu: A vonatkozó mellékmondat rövidíthető. Az -ing alak tevő jelentésű: «The man sitting there is my boss». A múlt idejű igenév szenvedő jelentésű: «The book written by Orwell is a classic». Az «első, utolsó, egyetlen» és a felsőfok után to-infinitív áll: «The first person to arrive gets a prize». Hivatalos szövegben gyakori: «Anyone wishing to apply should contact the office». Egy befejezett múltbeli eseményt nem lehet -ing alakkal rövidíteni.
speak.en: A relative clause can be shortened. The -ing form has an active meaning: «The man sitting there is my boss». The past participle has a passive meaning: «The book written by Orwell is a classic». After «first, last, only» and a superlative comes a to-infinitive: «The first person to arrive gets a prize». Common in official texts: «Anyone wishing to apply should contact the office». A finished past event cannot be shortened with -ing.
speak.es: Una oración de relativo se puede acortar. La forma -ing tiene sentido activo: «The man sitting there is my boss». El participio pasado tiene sentido pasivo: «The book written by Orwell is a classic». Después de «first, last, only» y de un superlativo va un to-infinitivo: «The first person to arrive gets a prize». Es común en textos oficiales: «Anyone wishing to apply should contact the office». Un hecho pasado terminado no se puede acortar con -ing.
speak.de: Ein Relativsatz lässt sich verkürzen. Die -ing-Form hat aktive Bedeutung: «The man sitting there is my boss». Das Partizip Perfekt hat passive Bedeutung: «The book written by Orwell is a classic». Nach «first, last, only» und einem Superlativ steht ein to-Infinitiv: «The first person to arrive gets a prize». In amtlichen Texten üblich: «Anyone wishing to apply should contact the office». Ein abgeschlossenes vergangenes Ereignis lässt sich nicht mit -ing verkürzen.
